instruction: Access the travel deals and offers page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Navigate from United Airlines homepage to travel deals and offers page. Uses same URL pattern matching evaluator. Similar difficulty to original task (single navigation goal within same website).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_tab_info getter to extract the current active tab URL
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match appropriately checks URL pattern against expected value
Expected pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/special-offers' accurately identifies United Airlines travel deals and offers page
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (accessing the travel deals page)
Logic flow is correct: getter extracts URL from accessibility tree, metric performs regex search, returns 1.0 if pattern matches
Runtime feasibility: getter can access active tab state via accessibility tree and Playwright, metric comparison will work correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: get_active_tab_info reloads the page which could cause issues if the page has session state or redirects, but should work fine for this public United Airlines page
Consider: Pattern matching uses re.search (matches anywhere in URL) rather than full match, but this is actually appropriate for URL matching with potential query parameters
